rows.label: Yield

rows.n: Computed by the atlas: the world sum minus China, both USDA PSD figures of the same market year

balance.n: USDA PSD, Rice, Milled: the world is the sum of the countries the file lists (it has no world row); domestic use is the PSD attribute 'Domestic Consumption'. Stocks-to-use is ending stocks divided by domestic use, exports not counted. The PSD file carries no label: the atlas calls the newest marketing year the forecast and the one before it the estimate (the atlas's words; USDA's World Agricultural Production circular, https://apps.fas.usda.gov/psdonline/circulars/production.pdf, heads the same two years 'Prel.' and 'Proj.' in its tables)

flows.n: Atlas conversion, milled equivalent: CEPII BACI 2024 customs weight is 5.00 Mt, of which 5.00 Mt is paddy (HS 1006.10), converted at the USDA PSD milling rate of Cambodia (0.61, market year 2025/26)

notes: Flows are BACI calendar-2024 customs flows; ranked trade tables are USDA PSD market year 2026/27, a forecast (trader reference). Years differ.
PSD rice is on a milled basis; PSD 'Exports' are market-year (not trade-year) figures.

Customs flows cover HS 1006.10 to 1006.40. Paddy (7.95 Mt in 2024, CEPII BACI) is converted to milled equivalent with the USDA PSD milling rate of the exporter, so that flows compare with the milled-basis tables; such flows are marked Atlas conversion. Husked rice (HS 1006.20) stays at customs weight. The seaborne total and the map lanes still use customs weight.
